text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging: latency-slo-breach detected on /v1/streaming/generate p99 > 1.2s for last 5m. Affected cluster: eu-west-1-prod-gpu-pool-7. Escalation level: P1.

javier: ack-ing, jumping on it. grabbing logs and link to dashboard.

priya: I'm on call. adding traces, looks like tail spikes are correlated with recent int8 calibration rollouts (profile id: calib-2026-04-int8-09).

leo: note: we pushed that calibration to shards in eu-west-1 two hours ago. saw small regressions locally but not full spike.

javier: copying metrics: p95 went from 120ms -> 420ms, p99 from 240ms -> 1.35s, stream stall rate +5% over baseline. Several streaming connections hit continuous token emission stalls for 3-6s.

priya: logs snippet: ```ERROR kv_cache: failed_dequantize: timeout=250ms model=redwood-int8-v2 shard=7
streaming_manager: stall_detected prefix_len=512 seq=1024 stall_ms=3600
sched: batch_wait=180ms batch_k=12```

javier: hypothesis: calibration changed some dequant kernel path that's causing KV cache lock contention under continuous-batch streaming pattern. locks held longer, which pushes queue depths up -> stalls.

tina_eng: can we revert the calibration flag for that profile at runtime? we have a feature flag to fall back to previous quant profile.

javier: attempting rollback via control plane now: `revert_quant_profile --profile calib-2026-04-int8-09 --target eu-west-1-prod-gpu-pool-7`

incident-bot: Action queued. Rollback job id: rb-2026-04-0009. ETA ~ 90s per shard to drain and reload.

emily_cs: customer alert draft: "We're investigating increased response latency for streaming endpoints in eu-west-1. We're mitigating and will follow up within 30 minutes." approve?

sarah_ops: +1 send it, include mitigation steps and ask customers to DM if they see errors.

leo: while rollback is in progress, can we route traffic off the affected dedicated pool to fallback pool (eu-west-1-gpu-pool-3 fp8-safe)? That will incur higher cost but lower latencies.

priya: creating routing override: `route-policy set /v1/streaming/generate region=eu-west-1 prefer_pool=eu-west-1-gpu-pool-3 max_burst=200`

incident-bot: Route override applied. Traffic rebalancing started.

javier: monitoring: within 2m p95 dropped to 210ms, p99 to 480ms. Stall rate down to +1.2%. Rollback still completing on original pool.

tina_eng: rolling restart of streaming workers on affected pool to clear stuck KV locks post-rollback. command: `shardctl restart-pool eu-west-1-prod-gpu-pool-7 --grace 45s`

priya: FYI, we also observed a small subset of requests hitting a new kernel path that lacks a fast-path for prefix=0 streaming. adding a short-term patch to skip new kernel when prefix_len > 256.

javier: patch applied as runtime override: `kernel_pref skip_new_fastpath if prefix_len > 256` — will keep for 1h while we validate.

emily_cs: customer comms updated: "Mitigation in progress: routing traffic and rolling back recent int8 calibration in the affected region. We'll update within 15 minutes or sooner if resolved." Sent to impacted accounts.

leo: digging into flamegraphs: contention hotspots in `dequantize_kernel::acquire_locks()` and `kv_cache::serialize_update()`. Looks like calibration changed quant table sizes causing extra lock churn.

priya: can we repro locally with a traffic replay to a staging shard using the new calibration? I want to run the exact streaming workload (prefix heavy) and measure.

tina_eng: yes, grabbed a trace and started replay on staging. initial repro shows p99 ~ 900ms with new calibration vs 180ms baseline.

javier: rollback finished on 7/8 shards; last shard draining now. overall SLOs returning: p95=130ms, p99=240ms, stream stall rate back to baseline.

incident-bot: Incident state update: partial mitigation achieved. All customer-facing errors cleared. Continue monitoring for 30m.

emily_cs: ongoing: 3 customers reported higher latency during window (1.8-2.3s). CS handling and shared postmortem to affected accounts.

sarah_ops: scheduling on-call handoff: Priya stays for next 2 hours, then Javier covers overnight. Please log any follow-ups in #postmortems.

leo: action items captured: 1) revert calibration publish workflow to require kernel perf smoke test for streaming prefix cases; 2) add lock contention alerts on kv_cache dequant path; 3) add per-profile canary rollout at 1% traffic for 30m; 4) add automated fallback to fp8-safe profile if p99 > 800ms for >5m.

priya: I'll own items 1 and 3. Tina will own 2, Leo will do 4.

javier: quick retro note: calibrations are great but need to preserve streaming-fastpaths. let's add a checklist to the calibration release plan.

incident-bot: Reminder: create incident timeline doc and link to postmortem template.

emily_cs: post-incident communication scheduled, will coordinate with legal for wording.

sarah_ops: closing note: thanks everyone for the quick pivot. we'll reconvene for a 30m postmortem in 2 hours. :thumbsup:

javier: moving thread to #postmortems once doc is created.

priya: staying on monitors for the handoff.

(End of thread)
